description: This file defines utility functions for managing and validating theme tokens, specifically extending Ant Design's theme tokens with Superset-specific custom tokens. It includes functions to get all valid tokens, check token validity, and categorize tokens by source.

methods.name: getValidTokenNames
methods.description: Retrieves a set of all valid token names, combining Ant Design's tokens with Superset-specific custom tokens, with caching for performance.

methods.name: isValidTokenName
methods.description: Checks if a given token name is recognized either by Ant Design or as a Superset custom token.

methods.name: isSupersetCustomToken
methods.description: Checks if a given token name is a Superset-specific custom token.

methods.name: getAllValidTokenNames
methods.description: Returns an object categorizing all valid token names into Ant Design tokens and Superset custom tokens, along with total count.
